reading.title: Rigorous Analysis Confirms NASA’s Artemis II Heat Shield Performance
reading.summary: NASA’s Artemis II mission sent four astronauts around the Moon and brought them safely back to Earth, laying a foundation for crewed flights to the Moon’s surface. Additional engineering data analysis of the Orion spacecraft’s heat shield confirmed initial data showing the heat shield performed as expected. news.title: Zelenskyy sits down with NPR. And, Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer
news.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has a sit-down interview with NPR as Russia's full-scale invasion nears the 5-year mark. And, Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer.
